display_name: Interpretation Act (Canada), R.S.C., 1985, c. I-21: time, commencement, repeal and rules of construction, in L4

l4_build.note: check.sh was run with L4_TARGET=unstable; the comparison with a main build was not made, because the encoding uses REFUSE, #ASSERT REFUSED, @lang and YMD, which a main build rejects.

expected_red_note: ten deliberately failing expectations, each written from the text and each a different way a plausible but wrong reading would answer; they are counted by check.sh (expected_failed = 10) and are kept to show the tests can fail.

scope.encoded: The last day of a period of N days, months or years after, from or before a day (ss 27, 28, 37(1)); clear days; whether a day falls inside a period; the day a thing may be done when the last day is a holiday (s 26, with holidays supplied by the caller); the day and moment an Act, a regulation, a proclamation or an appointment binds or takes effect (ss 5, 6, 7, 18(3), 23); expiry (s 6(1)); age (s 30); calendar, financial and Dominical years (s 37); the time to lay a regulation before Parliament (s 39(1)); repeal, replacement and annulment (ss 2(2), 39(2), 43, 44, 46); standard time and the time of day (ss 35(1), 29); and a number of rules of construction (ss 2(1) regulation, 3(1), 8, 9, 11, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23(1), 25(1), 32, 34, 35(1), 35(2), 41(1), the Schedule).
scope.not_encoded: Thirty section groups are inert (reading rules, grants of power, definitions that name things by reference to other law); see the coverage table in NOTES.md. Weeks, deemed service and notice, and days of rest, recess or closed offices that are not holidays are refused because the text is silent; the days of the holidays the text names without a date are the caller's. The French version is not encoded.

source.text: R.S.C.-1985-c.-I-21.txt (unofficial plain-text rendering; English version only)

method: A single Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone from the brief, without subagents and without reading any other encoding of interpretation law. Expected values were written from the text before the code and are in NOTES.md section 4; no expected value was changed to match the code's output.
not_reviewed: No domain expert, lawyer or second encoder has read this against the statute. The French version has not been consulted. The text is an unofficial rendering that has not been checked against the official consolidation. The question whether an L4 encoding that quotes the text may rely on the Open Government Licence - Canada is a human decision that is still open (SOURCE-LICENSE.md).
